children: According to Wallstreetcn, Turkey summoned Ukraine's ambassador in Ankara after two Turkey-operated ships were attacked in the Black Sea, with the Turkish Foreign Ministry saying it expressed its position on the incidents and stressed the need to ensure safety of life, property, navigation, and the environment in the Black Sea region.

title: Turkey Summons Ukrainian Ambassador After Black Sea Ship Attacks
